steps.label: browser turn right
steps.say: Turn the BROWSER knob slowly to the RIGHT, about 5 clicks

steps.label: browser turn left
steps.say: Turn the BROWSER knob slowly to the LEFT, about 5 clicks

steps.label: browser press
steps.say: PRESS the BROWSER knob once

steps.label: browser turn right + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and turn the BROWSER right, 5 clicks

steps.label: browser press + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and PRESS the BROWSER knob

steps.label: STEMS / Neural Mix centre button
steps.say: Press the round N (Neural Mix) logo in the centre

steps.label: STEMS centre button + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press the N logo

steps.label: master min->max
steps.say: Turn MASTER all the way LEFT, then all the way RIGHT

steps.label: crossfader left->right
steps.say: Move the CROSSFADER fully LEFT, then fully RIGHT

steps.label: A LOAD (button 1)
steps.say: Press the small round button 1 (LOAD deck 1)

steps.label: A LOAD + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press button 1

steps.label: A SYNC
steps.say: Press SYNC on deck 1

steps.label: A SYNC + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press SYNC

steps.label: A CUE
steps.say: Press CUE on deck 1

steps.label: A CUE + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press CUE

steps.label: A PLAY
steps.say: Press PLAY on deck 1

steps.label: A PLAY + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press PLAY

steps.label: A PFL / headphones
steps.say: Press HEADPHONES button 1

steps.label: A PFL + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press HEADPHONES 1

steps.label: A mode HOT CUE
steps.say: Press the HOT CUE mode button on deck 1

steps.label: A mode HOT CUE + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press HOT CUE (PITCH PLAY)

steps.label: A mode LOOP
steps.say: Press the LOOP mode button on deck 1

steps.label: A mode LOOP + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press LOOP (BOUNCE LOOP)

steps.label: A mode FX
steps.say: Press the FX mode button on deck 1

steps.label: A mode FX + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press FX (SLICER)

steps.label: A mode NEURAL MIX
steps.say: Press the NEURAL MIX mode button on deck 1

steps.label: A mode NEURAL MIX + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT and press NEURAL MIX (SAMPLER)

steps.label: A EQ HIGH min->max
steps.say: Turn HIGH/GAIN (deck 1) fully LEFT, then fully RIGHT

steps.label: A GAIN (SHIFT + HIGH) min->max
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT, turn HIGH/GAIN fully LEFT, then RIGHT

steps.label: A EQ MID min->max
steps.say: Turn MID (deck 1) fully LEFT, then fully RIGHT

steps.label: A EQ LOW min->max
steps.say: Turn LOW (deck 1) fully LEFT, then fully RIGHT

steps.label: A FILTER left->centre->right
steps.say: Turn FILTER (deck 1) fully LEFT, back to the CENTRE, then fully RIGHT

steps.label: A volume fader down->up
steps.say: Move the VOLUME fader (deck 1) fully DOWN, then fully UP

steps.label: A tempo fader top->bottom
steps.say: Move the TEMPO fader (deck 1) to the TOP, then to the BOTTOM

steps.label: A jog touch (hold 2 s)
steps.say: TOUCH the top of the JOG (deck 1), hold 2 seconds, let go. Don't turn it

steps.label: A jog top 1 turn clockwise
steps.say: Hand ON TOP of the JOG (deck 1): exactly ONE full turn CLOCKWISE

steps.label: A jog top 1 turn counter-clockwise
steps.say: Hand ON TOP: ONE full turn COUNTER-clockwise

steps.label: A jog ring 1 turn clockwise
steps.say: Only the OUTER EDGE of the JOG (deck 1): ONE full turn CLOCKWISE

steps.label: A jog ring 1 turn counter-clockwise
steps.say: OUTER EDGE only: ONE full turn COUNTER-clockwise

steps.label: A jog top 1 turn clockwise + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 1 SHIFT, hand ON TOP: ONE full turn CLOCKWISE

steps.label: A pads 1-8 in HOT CUE
steps.say: Press HOT CUE, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)

steps.label: A SHIFT + pads 1-8 in HOT CUE
steps.say: Still HOT CUE: hold deck 1 SHIFT and press pads 1→8

steps.label: A pads 1-8 in LOOP
steps.say: Press LOOP, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)

steps.label: A SHIFT + pads 1-8 in LOOP
steps.say: Still LOOP: hold deck 1 SHIFT and press pads 1→8

steps.label: A pads 1-8 in FX
steps.say: Press FX, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)

steps.label: A SHIFT + pads 1-8 in FX
steps.say: Still FX: hold deck 1 SHIFT and press pads 1→8

steps.label: A pads 1-8 in NEURAL MIX
steps.say: Press NEURAL MIX, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)

steps.label: A SHIFT + pads 1-8 in NEURAL MIX
steps.say: Still NEURAL MIX: hold deck 1 SHIFT and press pads 1→8

steps.label: A pads 1-8 in PITCH PLAY
steps.say: Hold SHIFT + press HOT CUE (= PITCH PLAY), let go, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)

steps.label: A SHIFT + pads 1-8 in PITCH PLAY
steps.say: Still PITCH PLAY: hold deck 1 SHIFT and press pads 1→8

steps.label: A pads 1-8 in BOUNCE LOOP
steps.say: Hold SHIFT + press LOOP (= BOUNCE LOOP), let go, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)

steps.label: A SHIFT + pads 1-8 in BOUNCE LOOP
steps.say: Still BOUNCE LOOP: hold deck 1 SHIFT and press pads 1→8

steps.label: A pads 1-8 in SLICER
steps.say: Hold SHIFT + press FX (= SLICER), let go, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)

steps.label: A SHIFT + pads 1-8 in SLICER
steps.say: Still SLICER: hold deck 1 SHIFT and press pads 1→8

steps.label: A pads 1-8 in SAMPLER
steps.say: Hold SHIFT + press NEURAL MIX (= SAMPLER), let go, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)

steps.label: A SHIFT + pads 1-8 in SAMPLER
steps.say: Still SAMPLER: hold deck 1 SHIFT and press pads 1→8

steps.label: B LOAD (button 2)
steps.say: Press the small round button 2 (LOAD deck 2)

steps.label: B LOAD + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT and press button 2

steps.label: B SYNC
steps.say: Press SYNC on deck 2

steps.label: B SYNC + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT and press SYNC

steps.label: B CUE
steps.say: Press CUE on deck 2

steps.label: B CUE + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT and press CUE

steps.label: B PLAY
steps.say: Press PLAY on deck 2

steps.label: B PLAY + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT and press PLAY

steps.label: B PFL / headphones
steps.say: Press HEADPHONES button 2

steps.label: B PFL + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT and press HEADPHONES 2

steps.label: B mode HOT CUE
steps.say: Press the HOT CUE mode button on deck 2

steps.label: B mode HOT CUE + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT and press HOT CUE (PITCH PLAY)

steps.label: B mode LOOP
steps.say: Press the LOOP mode button on deck 2

steps.label: B mode LOOP + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT and press LOOP (BOUNCE LOOP)

steps.label: B mode FX
steps.say: Press the FX mode button on deck 2

steps.label: B mode FX + SHIFT
steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT and press FX (SLICER)

steps.label: B mode NEURAL MIX
steps.say: Press the NEURAL MIX mode button on deck 2

steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT and press NEURAL MIX (SAMPLER)

steps.label: B EQ HIGH min->max
steps.say: Turn HIGH/GAIN (deck 2) fully LEFT, then fully RIGHT

steps.label: B GAIN (SHIFT + HIGH) min->max
steps.say: Hold deck 2 SHIFT, turn HIGH/GAIN fully LEFT, then RIGHT

steps.label: B EQ MID min->max

steps.label: B FILTER left->centre->right

steps.label: B jog top 1 turn counter-clockwise

steps.label: B pads 1-8 in HOT CUE
steps.say: Press HOT CUE, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)

steps.label: B SHIFT + pads 1-8 in HOT CUE

steps.label: B pads 1-8 in LOOP

steps.label: B SHIFT + pads 1-8 in LOOP

steps.label: B pads 1-8 in BOUNCE LOOP
steps.say: Hold SHIFT + press LOOP (= BOUNCE LOOP), let go, then pads 1→8 (top row, then bottom row)
